pr_title: Remove an unnecessary expression in NioEventLoop
pr_body:
Motivation:

Remove an unnecessary expression to make the code more readable

Modification:

Remove `eventLoop == null`

Result:

Fixes #9725
pr_comments: Can one of the admins verify this patch?
@MrYangxf also please sign our ICLA: https://netty.io/s/icla

issue_context.title: A redundant comparison operation
comments: processSelectedKey should be an hot path and very likely to be compiled at C2 level so I don't think it would make any difference perf-wise. For readability is fine, agree :)
@MrYangxf sounds good... Can you please submit a PR ?

review_comments: this seems to violate the original logic. The healthy channel  may be closed when `eventLoop != this`
@MrYangxf not sure I understand your concern... With your change `return` is the last statement in the method which makes it redundant.. What I am missing ?
@normanmaurer  ...`return` is contained in the `if(!k.isValid())` statement instead of the last line of the method...
@MrYangxf doh! stupid me ... I did not notice that there is another scope. You are right, of course.
